# MyWunderTale

> MyWunderTale is a free bedtime story app for iPhone, iPad and Android, made by Attain AI Labs LLC (Bellevue, Washington, USA). It reads original audio stories aloud with the child's name, and optionally a grown-up's ("Mom", "Dad", or a custom term), woven into every story. Narration is generated on the device by natural-sounding text-to-speech voices, so the app works fully offline, has no ads, needs no account, and keeps children's details on the phone.

## Key facts

- Platforms: iOS, iPadOS, Android. Language: English.
- Price: free to download. No ads. No account or sign-up.
- Audience: children roughly 3 to 11 years old; each story lists a suggested age range.
- Personalization: child's first name, age and pronouns; stories for one child or two siblings together; optional grown-up character; adjustable, previewable name pronunciation.
- Offline: narrator voices are installed with the app; no internet is needed to play stories.
- Privacy: profiles stay on the device; no analytics or advertising SDKs; data is only sent when a grown-up submits feedback.
- Themes: adventure, imagination, learning, feelings, morals, habits, bedtime, travel, fun.
- Bedtime controls: sleep timer (15, 30 or 60 minutes), autoplay, reading speed 0.75x to 1.1x, read-along text, choice of narrator, ambient music, lock-screen controls, optional nightly storytime reminder, parental gate.
